title: "Analysis"
engine: knitr

This is an example of how you'd add a page to the site with some inline code. Notice that the _quarto.yml file needs to be updated to reflect this page's existence.

## Example

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

d <- read_csv("data/example_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "Placeholder chart — replace with a real figure once there's real data."
ggplot(d, aes(x = id, y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal()
```
